description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Zynga is a global interactive entertainment company that creates social gaming experiences. The Game of Thrones Slots team is seeking a Software Engineer to develop slot gameplay, UI/UX features, engine-level systems, backend functionality, and tools using Unity, C#, and PHP. The role also involves defining tasks, addressing technical challenges, and triaging bugs.
Software Engineer building slot games and engine tools in Unity/C#, extending backend systems and fixing bugs

Responsibilities:
• Architect and develop features and slot game functionality in Unity with C#, and on the server backend (PHP preferred)
• Dive into the internals of slot engine systems to extend them as-needed
• Develop tools for engineering and content creators
• Define and scope out tasks & systems
• Triage and address bugs quickly

Requirements:
• * B.Sc. in Computer Science, or equivalent
• * 1–2 years of industry experience as a Software Developer
• Candidates from other fields should have 3+ years of relevant software engineering experience
• * Experience with git
• * Strong working knowledge of Unity and C#
• * Experience building features on a server backend (PHP preferred)
• * Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms and software methodologies
• * Excellent communication skills and comfort working in a collaborative environment

Preferred:
• * Mobile game development experience
• * Performance profiling and optimization experience
• * Experience developing Slot Machines
